title: Performance: Process Command Line Truncation Fix
problem: Process details tools truncate command-line arguments at 260 characters. Need full command-line capture for forensics.
cause: WMI Win32_Process.CommandLine truncates at 260 chars. Need alternative source (Win32_ProcessStartTrace or CIM).

recommended_actions.action: Use Win32_ProcessStartTrace for full command-line capture

lesson_learned: Win32_ProcessStartTrace has different limitations than WMI (e.g., not available on all Windows versions). Full command-line capture requires multi-source strategy and careful fallback logic.
